component.name: Kaminari
component.summary: Native KDE Plasma client for Matrix

description.p: Kaminari is a native KDE Frameworks 6 and Kirigami edition of Lightning, a desktop messenger for Matrix, the open network for secure, decentralised communication.

Conversations are organised into Spaces, rooms and threads. Send rich text, pictures, files, voice messages, polls, reactions and custom emoji, and find something you sent months ago without scrolling back to it.

Private rooms are end-to-end encrypted throughout: verify your other devices by comparing emoji, restore your keys from backup, and search even your encrypted rooms with an index that never leaves this computer.
Group voice calls and screen sharing run in the room itself, with Plasma color-scheme sync, native StatusNotifierItem system tray, KNotifications, and KDE global shortcuts.
Kirigami 6 and KDE Plasma 6 native desktop edition matching Lightning 0.10.5, with live Plasma color-scheme sync, StatusNotifierItem tray, KNotifications, and KDE GlobalAccel hotkeys.
